name: check_run_403_app_only
notes: Gate ladder rung 1 (§4.7, E18/AC-24). The Check Runs API only accepts a GitHub App installation token, so a PAT gets this 403. It is EXPECTED BEHAVIOUR, not an error: fall through to the commit status, and record which rung was reached in gate.delivery. Nothing about this response may mark the run degraded on its own.

body.message: Resource not accessible by personal access token
